title: Reg Park “Powerbuilder”
author: Andrew C.
desc:
Run this for 8 weeks before running schedule 2 (coming in the future)

This is based around n a workout from reg park publishing’s, taken from golden era bookworm video

ex.note: Add 100 lbs and do a half partial
Add another 100 and do a quarter partial
As heavy as possible and hold at shoulders for 5 seconds
Can probably sub for overhead press
Add weight last 2 sets and cheat on the curls
